## Load Xenium Object

```{r load_obj}
xenium.obj <- LoadXenium("<DATA_ROOT>/high_res_ST/atera/data/WTA_Preview_FFPE_Breast_Cancer/outs",
                          fov = "fov", segmentations="cell", flip.xy=TRUE)
xenium.obj
```

```{r}
metadata <- xenium.obj@meta.data
head(metadata, n=3)
# BlankCodeword: background noise
# ControlCodeword: 
# ControlProbe: negative control probe -> detect false postive 
```

## plot spatial plots

### plot nCounts spatial plot

```{r}
# You can change "repr.plot.width" below to change plot width
# You can change "repr.plot.height" below to change plot height
options(repr.plot.width=10, repr.plot.height=16)

# max.cutoff="q95" - Color is capped at 95th percentile
ImageFeaturePlot(xenium.obj, fov = "fov",
                 features = c("nCount_Xenium"),
                 max.cutoff="q95")+
  scale_y_reverse()
```

### plot a specific gene

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width=5, repr.plot.height=7)
ImageFeaturePlot(xenium.obj, features = "ERBB2",
                 max.cutoff ="q95", cols=c("black","white"))+
  scale_y_reverse()

options(repr.plot.width=5, repr.plot.height=7)
ImageFeaturePlot(xenium.obj, features = "IL7R",
                 max.cutoff ="q95", cols=c("black","white"))+
  scale_y_reverse()
```

## downstream analysis
### Data preprocessing
#### QC

```{r}
hist(xenium.obj$nCount_Xenium, breaks = 100)
#abline(v = 100, col="red")
```

```{r}
hist(xenium.obj$nCount_Xenium,xlim=c(0,1000), breaks = 1000)
abline(v = 100, col="red")
```

#### filtering cells based on detected transcripts per cell
#### Upper limit cutoff - 98th percentile
#### Lower limit cutoff - 100 determined by the previous plot

```{r}
thres <- quantile(xenium.obj$nCount_Xenium, c(0.98))
xenium.obj <- subset(xenium.obj, subset = nCount_Xenium >= 100 & nCount_Xenium <= thres[1])
```

```{r}
## Normalization
## library size based normalization, scale factor - median transcript count
xenium.obj <- NormalizeData(xenium.obj, scale.factor=median(xenium.obj$nCount_Xenium))
```
```{r}
## Find top 2k variable genes
xenium.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(xenium.obj)
## data scaling
xenium.obj <- ScaleData(xenium.obj)
## PCA for dimensionality reduction
xenium.obj <- RunPCA(xenium.obj, verbose = FALSE)
## 2D projection by UMAP
xenium.obj <- RunUMAP(xenium.obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## clustering
xenium.obj <- FindNeighbors(xenium.obj, dims = 1:30)
xenium.obj <- FindClusters(xenium.obj, resolution = 0.1)
```
```{r}
for (i in seq(0.1,1,0.1)) {
  xenium.obj <- FindClusters(xenium.obj, resolution = i)
}

```
#### clustering
```{r}
## plot clustering results in UMAP
options(repr.plot.width=8, repr.plot.height=8)
lapply(seq(0.1,1,0.1), function(i){
  p <- DimPlot(xenium.obj,group.by = paste0('Xenium_snn_res.',i),cols = c(.cluster_cols,my36colors))
  return(p)
})->plist
pdf('diff_resolution_umap_plots.pdf')
print(plist)
dev.off()
```
```{r}
options(repr.plot.width=10, repr.plot.height=14)
resolutions <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)

for (i in resolutions) {
  p <- ImageDimPlot(
    xenium.obj,
    group.by = paste0("Xenium_snn_res.", i),
    cols = c(.cluster_cols, my36colors)
  ) + 
    scale_y_reverse()

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("imgplot_res_", i, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 14,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
```{r}
clustering_res <- xenium.obj@meta.data[,13:23]
write.table(clustering_res, "seurat_clustering_results.csv",
              col.names=TRUE, row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=",")
# NOTE: xenium_obj.rds.gz is saved AFTER the cell-type annotation block below,
# so the object carries major_celltype/minor_celltype (prep_atera_xenium_cells.R
# requires major_celltype). See the save at the end of the annotation chunk.

```
```{r}
for (i in seq(0.1,1,0.1)) {
  all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(xenium.obj, only.pos = TRUE,group.by = paste0("Xenium_snn_res.", i),
                              min.pct = 0.05, logfc.threshold = 1)
  
}

```
### Top markers check
```{r}
library(dplyr)

markers_0.1 <- read.csv("FindAllMarkers_res_0.1.csv")

colnames(markers_0.1)
head(markers_0.1)

fc_col <- 'avg_log2FC'

top_n <- 10

top_markers_0.1 <- markers_0.1 %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(.data[[fc_col]]), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  ungroup()

top_genes_0.1 <- unique(top_markers_0.1$gene)

print(top_markers_0.1)
print(top_genes_0.1)

p <- DotPlot(
  xenium.obj,
  features = top_genes_0.1,
  group.by = "Xenium_snn_res.0.1"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  ggtitle("Top markers per cluster (res = 0.1)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)
ggsave(
  filename = "DotPlot_top_markers_res_0.1.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 20,
  height = 8
)

```
### cell annotations
```{r}
major_map <- c(
  "0"  = "epi",
  "1"  = "stroma",
  "2"  = "imm",
  "3"  = "epi",
  "4"  = "stroma",
  "5"  = "epi",
  "6"  = "epi",
  "7"  = "imm",
  "8"  = "imm",
  "9"  = "stroma",
  "10" = "epi"
)

# ---------- minor cell type ----------
minor_map <- c(
  "0"  = "Luminal_tumor_cells",
  "1"  = "CAFs",
  "2"  = "T_cells",
  "3"  = "Luminal_progenitor_like_cells",
  "4"  = "vascular_endothelial_cells",
  "5"  = "Basal_like_tumor_cells",
  "6"  = "Myoepithelial_like_cells",
  "7"  = "Plasma_cells",
  "8"  = "Mast_cells",
  "9"  = "Lymphatic_endothelial_cells",
  "10" = "Secretory_Apocrine_luminal_cells"
)

# 写入 metadata
xenium.obj$major_celltype <- unname(major_map[as.character(xenium.obj$Xenium_snn_res.0.1)])
xenium.obj$minor_celltype <- unname(minor_map[as.character(xenium.obj$Xenium_snn_res.0.1)])

# 设定顺序，保证画图时顺序稳定
xenium.obj$major_celltype <- factor(
  xenium.obj$major_celltype,
  levels = c("epi", "imm", "stroma")
)

xenium.obj$minor_celltype <- factor(
  xenium.obj$minor_celltype,
  levels = c(
    "Luminal_tumor_cells",
    "Luminal_progenitor_like_cells",
    "Basal_like_tumor_cells",
    "Myoepithelial_like_cells",
    "Secretory_Apocrine_luminal_cells",
    "T_cells",
    "Plasma_cells",
    "Mast_cells",
    "CAFs",
    "vascular_endothelial_cells",
    "Lymphatic_endothelial_cells"
  )
)

table(xenium.obj$Xenium_snn_res.0.1, xenium.obj$major_celltype)
table(xenium.obj$Xenium_snn_res.0.1, xenium.obj$minor_celltype)

# Save the annotated object (moved here from above so it carries
# major_celltype/minor_celltype). prep_atera_xenium_cells.R reads it from the
# clustering/ dir (= the setwd target at the top of this notebook).
saveRDS(xenium.obj,
        '<DATA_ROOT>/high_res_ST/atera/processed_data/clustering/xenium_obj.rds.gz',
        compress = 'gzip')

major_markers <- c(
  # epi
  "EPCAM", "KRT8", "KRT18", "KRT19", "MUC1", "PIP", "SCGB2A2", "KRT17", "TP63",
  # imm
  "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "JCHAIN", "MZB1", "CPA3", "KIT", "MS4A2",
  # stroma
  "COL1A1", "COL1A2", "LUM", "THBS2", "VWF", "KDR", "PECAM1", "PROX1", "LYVE1", "CCL21"
)

p_major <- DotPlot(
  xenium.obj,
  features = major_markers,
  group.by = "major_celltype"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  ggtitle("Major cell type markers") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_major)

ggsave(
  "DotPlot_major_category_markers.pdf",
  plot = p_major,
  width = 12,
  height = 6
)

```


### function
## Select sub-region of interest

### Select sub-region by coordinates

```{r}
min_x = 1000
min_y = 1000
max_x = 2000
max_y = 2000

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e10)
crop <- Crop(xenium.obj[["fov"]],
             x = c(min_x, max_x),
             y = c(min_y, max_y))
```

### Select sub-region by cell-ids

```{r}
# read csv
select_cells <- read.csv("./one-sample-analysis/Selection_1_cells_stats.csv", skip = 2, header = TRUE)
head(select_cells, n=3)
xenium.obj.sub <- subset(xenium.obj, cells = select_cells$Cell.ID)
xenium.obj.sub
```

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width=8, repr.plot.height=8)
ImageFeaturePlot(xenium.obj.sub, fov = "fov",
                 features = c("nCount_Xenium"),
                 cols = c("black","white"),
                 max.cutoff="q95")+
  scale_y_reverse()
```
